label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter flows directly to the response sink via string concatenation. Although a partial sanitization (replacing quotes) is applied, it fails to encode other dangerous characters (such as <, >, javascript:) required to prevent XSS. This constitutes a genuine cross-site scripting vulnerability on the reported path.

evidence.note: Weak quote replacement does not mitigate script tag injection; input concatenated unsafely
